g.text: Enterprise Operational Request Coordination & Concurrency System
• Atomic Claiming: WHERE assigned_to IS NULL
• OCC Version Checks: WHERE version = $v (409 Conflict)
Rejects invalid jumps (e.g. open ➔ resolved returns 422)
• Appends immutable diff to events table
• Powers full timeline rewind & SOC2 compliance
• Emits Socket events to joined rooms immediately
• Enqueues async email & webhook tasks into BullMQ
• Decoupled: fast HTTP response, async dispatch
• Exactly 1 operator wins, losers receive clean notice
• Uses version column to protect tickets from blind overwrites
• Conflicting updates return HTTP 409 Conflict with state
• Replaces blocking database row locks for high scale
• Offline Redis? Idempotency auto-falls back to SQL table
• API never crashes or hangs when Redis is unavailable
• Monthly partitions on events and work_items
• Cold archiving to object storage / warehouse
• Stateless API instances behind round-robin load balancer
• Redis-adapter for clustered Socket.io pub/sub broadcasts
